evidence: Each job card on the listing page (e.g. Senior Frontend Developer) shows title, company, industry badge, employment type badge, location, salary range, posting date, and required skill tags.
Job details page for job-1 shows title, company, industry, employment type, location, salary range, posted date, full description (with Responsibilities/Requirements), and required skills.
Homepage shows "Showing 8 jobs" matching 8 rendered job cards; clicking a card navigated to /jobs/job-1 details page.
Submitted valid application (name, email, phone, message) on job-1 and received toast "Application submitted! Your application for Senior Frontend Developer at TechCorp Solutions has been sent."

Submitting empty form focused/flagged required Name, Email, Message fields with native validation messages ("Please fill out this field"); invalid email "not-an-email" was flagged with "Please include an '@' in the email address" and focus moved to that field.

issue: Duplicate application with same email accepted for same job
actual: Submitted a second application to job-1 using the same email (test.user@example.com) already used for a prior application to that job. The app accepted it, showed a second "Application submitted!" success toast, and the employer dashboard's application list for that job shows both "Test User" and "Duplicate Test" as two separate records with the identical email, increasing the application count from 2 to 4 (should have been rejected, leaving the existing application unchanged).

evidence: Clicking the application-count button (e.g. "4") on a job row in the employer dashboard expanded an "Applications (4)" list showing each applicant's details for that specific job.

Expanded application list for Senior Frontend Developer shows each application as a distinct card with applicant name, email, phone (when provided), message, and a submission date (e.g. "Jan 20", "Yesterday").

Submitting the first application (Test User) produced a visible success toast and the application appeared exactly once in the employer dashboard's application list for that job with the correct name, email, phone, and message.

Posted "QA Automation Engineer" job with title, industry (Technology), employment type (Full-time), location (New York, NY), valid salary ($90k-$120k), description, and 2 skills. Success toast shown, job appeared in employer dashboard (Active Jobs 5→7... confirmed row) and in job-seeker listing (Showing 10 jobs, new card visible with all fields).

issue: Job posted despite invalid salary range and missing required skills
actual: Submitted the "Post a Job" form with title, industry, employment type, location, and description filled, minimum salary 100000, maximum salary 50000 (min > max), and no required skills added. The app accepted it, showed "Job posted successfully!", and the job "QA Test Sales Rep" appeared in both the employer dashboard and job-seeker listing displaying an invalid salary range "$100k - $50k" and no skills tags, instead of being rejected with validation feedback.

issue: No edit functionality exists for published jobs
actual: Inspected the employer dashboard job rows: each row only has an application-count toggle button and one icon button, which opens a "Delete this job?" confirmation dialog (confirmed via DOM inspection showing a trash2 icon and delete confirmation dialog). No edit button, pencil icon, or link to an edit form was found on the dashboard or on the job details page. There is no accessible way for an employer to edit a published job's details.

evidence: Clicked delete icon for "Marketing Manager" job; clicking Cancel in the confirmation dialog left the job intact. Clicking delete icon again then "Delete" removed the job: Active Jobs count dropped from 5 to 4, job disappeared from employer dashboard, and job-seeker listing count dropped from 8 to 7 with the job no longer listed.

Industry filter "Technology" alone reduced results to 2 jobs correctly; adding Location "Seattle, WA" combined filter narrowed to 1 correct job; adding Job Type "Full-time" combination produced accurate "Showing 0 jobs" no-results state; Clear filters button restored full 7-job list.

Each filter change immediately updated "Showing N jobs" count and the rendered card list without needing a submit action, including reaching a "No jobs found" empty state; Clear filters immediately restored the full list and count.

Searching "REACT" (uppercase) matched job-1 via its "React" skill tag; searching "techcorp" (lowercase) matched both TechCorp Solutions jobs by company name, case-insensitively, with immediate count/result updates.
Dashboard shows Active Jobs: 4 matching the 4 listed job rows (Marketing Manager was excluded after deletion), and Total Applications: 3 matching sum of per-job counts (2+1+0+0=3).

issue: All app state is in-memory only; reload wipes published jobs, applications, and deletions
actual: After posting two new jobs and submitting applications, navigating directly to a job URL (equivalent to a reload of that route) caused a full page reload that reset the entire app back to the original 8 seed jobs — the newly posted jobs, submitted applications, and the deleted "Marketing Manager" job's absence were all lost; the app showed "Job not found" for the newly created job and the homepage reverted to "Showing 8 jobs" with Marketing Manager restored. No localStorage or IndexedDB persistence was found (both empty), confirming state is kept only in memory.

issue: Newly submitted/posted items show an incorrect relative date ("Yesterday" instead of "Today")
actual: Submitted an application and posted new jobs at 2026-08-25 00:2x UTC (matching the browser's current date/time of Aug 25, 2026). The employer dashboard displayed the new application's submission date as "Yesterday" and the new job postings as "Posted Yesterday" instead of "Today", indicating an off-by-one error in the relative date calculation.
